newsitem.title: CANADA: CGI GROUP TO BUY TELEGLOBE UNIT.
newsitem.headline: CGI GROUP TO BUY TELEGLOBE UNIT.

text.p: The CGI Group Inc said on Monday that it intended to acquire Teleglobe Inc's Insurance Systems group for C$20 million cash plus C$120 million of first preferred shares.
The shares are valued at C$45.58 per share on a pre-split basis, the independent information technology consulting firm said.
Each share carries one vote is and convertible one-for-one into Class A subordinate shares, it said.
CGI shares will be split two for one on August 12.

Montreal-based CGI said it intend to acquire the unit, its largest acquisition to date, by September 30. The insurance systems group is the third largest outsourced supplier of processing services for the property and casualty insurance industry in North America.

CGI is an independent information technology consulting company. "The acquisition would increase financial services as a percentage of CGI's overall revenues to approximately 58 percent, from 35 percent currently," it said.
The U.S.-headquartered unit has about 900 employees while CGI had revenue of about C$163.5 million in the last 12 months and about 2,900 consultants and staff.
